f.pu: To ensure the preservation of exceptional attributes of nature, and the full protection of flora, fauna and natural resources. The marine park is highly biodiverse, is home to vast coral banks, and hosts important humpback whale, sea turtle, seabird, and marine invertebrate populations.
f.re: 1. Fishing within the limits of the National Park is prohibited. 2. It is prohibited to disturb animals or collect specimens. 3. It is prohibited to discard any type of garbage in the water. 4. During dives, it is prohibited to use gloves or knives.
